'''Easar Togita''', of [[House Togita]], is the King of [[Shienar]]. 

== Appearance and Personality ==
Although his topknot is white with age, his face is unwrinkled. He is 5'7" tall and is slim.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Easar Togita|comp}} He is described as "compact".{{ref/book|14|7}} He is a hard man, but has an almost permanent hint of sadness in his eyes.{{ref/book|8|p}}

He is a fine soldier, wise ruler and skilled diplomat, but said to have the soul of a poet.{{ref||comp}}

== History ==
Easar Togita was born in {{ne|940}}. His banner is the White Hart, considered a national banner of Shienar as he is the current ruler.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Ch.28 The Borderlands}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Shienar}}

Sometime earlier in life, he won a battle against Trollocs at very heavy odds, earning him the nickname "Lion of [[Kabila]]".{{ref||comp}}

He married in {{ne|960}}, and his wife died in {{ne|989}}. He was still grieving her death many years later, and had written poetry for her. 

He had sons old enough to ride to war with him in {{ne|998}}.{{ref||comp}} One of his sons is married to Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]]'s daughter.{{Ref/book|8|p}}

When [[Amalisa Jagad]] was a child, he used to give her rides on his shoulders and she called him "Magami", "Little Uncle" in the [[Old Tongue]], a name she still uses in private with him.{{ref/book|2|4}}

He resides in the capital in [[Fal Moran]] in an unnamed residence.{{ref/book|2|4}}

== Activities ==
He led the Shienaran troops into battle at [[Tarwin's Gap]] to battle the [[Trolloc]]s.{{ref/book|1|48}} 

He meets with the other Borderland rulers and makes a blood pact with them before setting out and leaving the Borderlands to look for [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|8|p}}

The army travels to [[Braem Wood]] in [[Andor]] where it camps down for the winter. He, with the rest of the rulers, meets with [[Elayne Trakand]]. They agree with her to carry on moving south towards [[Murandy]] in exchange for her not raising a hostile hand against them as they travel.

Rand finally agrees to meet with all the Borderlander rulers in the city of [[Far Madding]]. [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]] takes the lead in negotiations and strikes Rand across the face. After being struck by the other three rulers, [[Paitar Nachiman]] asks Rand a question about [[Tellindal Tirraso]]. The four rulers then agree that Rand is the Dragon Reborn and officially meet with him. Rand demands their oath of allegiance; otherwise he will leave the Borderlander army to sit where it is and miss the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]].

Easar is one of the rulers arguing in Rand's defense on why everyone should sign the [[Dragon's Peace]]. With the timely arrival of [[Moiraine Damodred]], she manages to finally convince everyone that this needs to be done quoting the ''[[Karaethon Cycle]]''. To the Borderlander rulers she quotes:
:{{Quote|He call upon the mountains to kneel}}
All the rulers finally sign the document. He accompanied the other Borderlander rulers to [[Tarwin's Gap]], where one of four initial clashes between [[Light]] and [[Shadow]] in the [[Last Battle]] took place. Easar informs [[Lan]] that the entire Borderlander army will ride under the banner of [[Malkier]]. Easar is impressed with Lan's leadership when Lan lifts the troops morale around him with a stirring speech. They are about to retire for the night when the horns of alarm sound. Both turn around and head back into the conflict. Easar is with Lan when [[Dreadlords]] join the battle and start pummeling their army with the [[One Power]]. Lan orders the retreat of the Gap. He is assumed to have survived the conflict.
